environment_setting: Urban neighborhood in City B, where graffiti art is popular but often crosses into vandalism, creating tension between artists and property owners.
norm_base: Citizens Wilfully or recklessly destroying or damaging property belonging to another without reasonable excuse Guilty of vandalism

character_profile.name: Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: create a large mural in the neighborhood

legitimate.legitimate_action: Seeking permission from property owners to create a mural
legitimate.benefits: Creates a mural legally, gains recognition as an artist, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Time spent seeking permissions, potential rejection from property owners

illegal.illegal_action: Painting a mural on a private wall without permission
illegal.benefits: Completes the mural quickly, gains immediate artistic satisfaction
illegal.costs: Guilty of vandalism if caught, potential fines or community service

character_profile.name: Jordan Lee
character_profile.goal: maintain the appearance of her property

legitimate.legitimate_action: Allowing Alex to paint a mural after discussion
legitimate.benefits: Improves the aesthetic of her property, supports local art
legitimate.costs: Risk of dissatisfaction with the final mural, time spent discussing

illegal.illegal_action: Refusing to engage with Alex and reporting him to authorities preemptively
illegal.benefits: Avoids any risk of property damage, ensures no unauthorized art
illegal.costs: Damages community relations, potential backlash for overreacting

character_profile.name: Chris Morgan
character_profile.goal: encourage Alex to take bold artistic risks

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging Alex to seek permission for the mural
legitimate.benefits: Helps Alex avoid legal trouble, builds a positive reputation for street art
legitimate.costs: Goes against their own rebellious nature, less exciting for them

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging Alex to paint the mural without permission
illegal.benefits: Supports Alex's artistic freedom, aligns with their own values
illegal.costs: If Alex is caught, they may also face scrutiny or legal consequences
